messages:
sasha: Heads-up — we need a new compact routing/tenant metrics exporter from the runtime for Console dashboards. Want alignment on schema, retention, and a safe backfill plan.

Dave: +1. Can you scope what "compact" means here? samples vs full logs?

sasha: compact = pre-aggregated rollups at 15s, 1m, 1h intervals, plus a lightweight per-request sample for p50/p95 routing latency. No full request bodies.

maria: sounds reasonable. main concerns: cardinality (per-tenant, per-route, variant) and ingestion QPS to telemetry pipeline. Do we have numbers?

liam: runtime can emit route+tenant+variant keys. Estimated peak: ~35k samples/sec across fleet if we do 15s rollups (with current traffic). Rough token estimate ~1.2M tokens/min -> ~1.7GB/day compressed? rough calc.

toni: retention ask? Console product wants 90 days for historical drilldowns, but infra ops wants 14 days hot + archived longer. We should pick compromise.

sasha: proposal: 30 days hot in ClickHouse (per-minute/15s), 365-day monthly rollups (hourly) in cold storage. 30d hot keeps dashboards snappy and limits storage costs.

dave: agree with hybrid. For rollups, can we store p50/p95/count/sum? Keep bucketed latency histogram?

liam: yes: schema compact_route_v1 = {route, tenant, variant, window_start, window_len, count, sum_latency_ms, p50_ms, p95_ms}. Histograms add space; prefer percentiles precomputed in runtime.

maria: how about uniqueness/idempotency for exporter -> ingestion? We need dedupe keys for backfill and retries. Suggest (exporter_id, window_start, route_hash).

sasha: good call. We'll add exporter_id and seq. Also emitting a small checksum to detect partial writes.

infra-bot: Note: ingestion topic telemetry.compact-route expects protobuf v2; new schema must be registered in schema-registry. Backfill jobs require consumer group reset permissions.

dave: Backfill approach suggestion: incremental windowed backfill. 1) run distributed job that writes per-day partition to temp table; 2) validate checksums; 3) swap partitions into ClickHouse. Avoid full re-ingest of raw events.

maria: cost estimate for a 30-day full backfill (30 days * 1.7GB/day) ~51GB compressed input, but aggregation job overhead ~3-4x because of shuffle. Plan for ~200GB job workspace. OK with infra?

toni: should be fine. Need to schedule backfill outside peak and provide a kill switch. Also put a slow-rate ingest throttle on the realtime pipeline when backfill is running.

liam: implementation note: runtime will add a feature flag to toggle compact exporter on by tenant. default off for enterprise tenants until SLA confirmed.

sasha: UX ask for Console: dashboards need per-tenant drop-down + global rollup. Also an experiment to show routing p95 vs fallback rate as A/B. Will product own queries?

maria: product will own the dashboard queries; eng-platform will provide the materialized tables and example SQL. We'll also add a dashboard template to docs.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: runtime/compact-exporter v1 -> staging. Expected deploy window: 30m.

dave: Next steps: 1) liam to open PR with schema & exporter flag. 2) infra to prep schema-registry entry and temp ClickHouse partition layout. 3) maria/product to draft dashboard spec + retention SLAs. 4) schedule backfill window after staging sign-off.

sasha: tagging owners: @liam @toni @maria @dave. If no objections by EOD we'll proceed with staging deploy tomorrow. :thumbsup:

liam: I'll start the PR and include config snippet for export format:
```
{"schema": "compact_route_v1", "exporter_id": "runtime-compact-01", "window_sec": 15, "fields": ["route","tenant","variant","count","sum_latency_ms","p50_ms","p95_ms","checksum"]}
```

maria: thanks. I'll draft dashboard gdoc and share link here when ready.

sasha: great — closing loop, will post staging results in this thread.
